# Marketing Integration LLC

> Marketing Integration LLC helps small and mid-sized businesses grow, compete, and enter new markets — domestically and internationally. We combine marketing strategy, business consulting, market development, and execution to turn opportunity into sustainable revenue.

## What Marketing Integration LLC does (short answer)

Marketing Integration LLC helps small and mid-sized businesses out-plan, out-position, and out-execute larger competitors. We actively listen, analyze the market and competition, then build and execute measurable tactical plans. Clients work directly with Managing Director Jack Lee — no account managers, no hand-offs.

## Four disciplines (services)

1. **Marketing & Growth Strategy** — Brand and market positioning, customer segmentation, competitive differentiation, marketing strategy, demand generation, digital marketing, content strategy, customer acquisition, retention and loyalty, and marketing performance assessment.
2. **Business & Commercial Strategy** — Business growth strategy, market opportunity assessment, competitive analysis, business planning, revenue strategy, sales strategy, commercialization planning, pricing and value proposition, strategic partnerships, and growth opportunity evaluation.
3. **Market Development & Go-to-Market** — Go-to-market strategy, new-market assessment, customer identification, channel strategy, distributor and partner development, business development, market-entry planning, sales activation, opportunity qualification, and launch strategy.
4. **International Business Development** — Local insight, global perspective, practical execution. Evaluating and pursuing opportunities outside traditional markets, including overseas businesses entering the United States.

## Key people

- **Jack Lee** — Managing Director, Marketing Integration LLC. 20+ years helping small and mid-sized businesses outmaneuver larger competitors with digital, direct-to-consumer, and partnership marketing tactics. Graduate of the University of Illinois Chicago. Author of *The Ripple Effect: The Consequences of Good and Bad Marketing*. https://www.linkedin.com/in/jack-lee-39b2aa7

## Proven results (documented client outcomes)

- **CPG (oral care, NJ):** 27% average annual ROI across 4 consecutive years via targeted consumer promotion with significant market share gains.
- **Technology (computer enterprise, CA):** "friends & professionals" referral strategy delivered new client acquisition at scale in a mature B2B market.
- **Start-up (green lubricants, CT):** 32% annual cost reduction and positive cash flow in year one after a 3-year revenue decline.
- **Healthcare/SaaS (OK):** 100% customer engagement; 22% of clients drove a 25% increase in incremental product purchases.
- **Manufacturing (VA):** 90% cost reduction on an internal process; contributed to winning a $2.5M/year, 5-year contract.
- **Energy technology (Western Africa):** supported international expansion into Western Africa — market and competitive intelligence, grant and funding identification, international brand positioning, and relationships in the military and energy sectors — contributing to expanded market recognition, new business channels, and increased international revenue.

## Industries served

Consumer packaged goods · Technology & software · Healthcare & SaaS · Manufacturing · Agriculture · Eco-friendly / green products

## FAQ

- **What does Marketing Integration LLC do?** Helps small and mid-sized businesses grow, compete, and enter new markets — domestically and internationally — combining marketing strategy, business consulting, market development, and execution.
- **Who does it work with?** Business owners, CEOs, and leadership teams at small and mid-sized organizations across consumer packaged goods, technology, healthcare, manufacturing, and agriculture.
- **Where is it located?** Stamford, Connecticut (CT), serving Fairfield County, the New York metro area, and clients nationwide and internationally.
- **How is it different from a traditional agency?** It doesn't just recommend — it helps businesses move from opportunity to strategy to execution, aligning growth strategy and marketing with revenue.
- **How much does it cost?** Every engagement is scoped to goals and market. After a free strategy call, clients receive a clear proposal with defined deliverables and success metrics.
- **Does it help with international or new-market entry?** Yes — international business development is one of its four core disciplines, including overseas businesses entering the United States.
- **How do I get started?** Call 860-926-2780 or email jacklee@marketingintegrationllc.com. Managing Director Jack Lee personally discusses your goals.
